headline: 20.25 Acres in Cummings Valley — Build Your Dream Home
description: A remarkable 20.25-acre property within the Cummings Valley area of Tehachapi, offering amazing views for miles. Zoned A (Exclusive Agriculture) with a building pad already cleared, gated ranch entry in place, overhead power at the road, and an established access road to the site. Room here for far more than a house — a large shop or barn for RVs, boats, trailers and equipment, plus corrals or outbuildings, subject to Kern County permitting. Just around the corner from Doner Family Vineyard, Wine Tasting Room and Wedding Venue. Easy access to services and amenities within the City of Tehachapi. Tehachapis four distinct seasons bring green spring hillsides, dry summers, fall color and light winter snow.
location_context: Cummings Valley is one of Tehachapis most desirable areas, known for its agricultural heritage, wineries, and stunning mountain views. The property offers genuine privacy while remaining close to town amenities.
